title: Jomfru Maria som gudmor
world: Present-day rural eastern Norway. The poor family rents a small, shabby house at the end of a muddy gravel road where the forest begins. The godmother drives a long dark car with two silent men in dark coats in the back seat. Her house is a big, old, quiet wooden villa with long, cold corridors and tall windows; three plain white doors stand side by side at the end of the longest corridor. The star is small, white and sharp; the moon huge, cold and silver-white; the sun a glowing golden ball. Far off, past a main road and a great spruce forest, stands the big white manor everyone calls the castle, with a park, a stone-edged spring under an old oak, a chapel, an east wing and a grassy field below the park. The key has a small round tag.
palette: Rain and mud at a grey dusk at the start; inside the old villa, cold grey-white corridors lit by the star's sharp white, the moon's cold silver and the sun's molten gold; then a long, luminous Norwegian summer: pale green park lawns, dark spruce, white nights and a golden midsummer dusk. Accents: the godmother's deep blue and the ivory of the wedding dress.

cast.name: Jomfru Maria (gudmoren)
cast.description: En elegant, tidløs velgjører som betaler dåpen, oppdrar barnet i et stort stille hus og setter tre forbudte dører som prøve; hun tar barna for å speile sorg og straff, men gir til slutt alt tilbake.
cast.look: A tall, slender, serene woman who looks about thirty-five, with an oval face, calm dark-brown eyes, a straight nose, softly arched dark brows and a gentle, grave smile, and a faint, soft glow always around her head. A deep-blue silk shawl covers her dark hair. She wears a long, light cream wool coat over a deep-blue dress, a small silver lily brooch on the lapel, spotless pale-grey shoes and a simple pale leather handbag on her arm.
cast.portrait: Background: the long, quiet corridor of the old villa.

cast.name: Jenta som sjuåring
cast.description: Jenta som vokser opp i gudmorens store, stille hus. Da hun er sju, får hun nøkkelen med den lille brikken, og etter fire dager åpner hun den første døra.
cast.look: A small girl of seven with a heart-shaped face, a button nose, big curious grey-green eyes, rosy cheeks and long ash-blonde hair in a single plait with a coral-pink hair tie. She wears a peach-coloured cotton dress with short sleeves over white leggings and red canvas sneakers, and a small old key with a little round tag on a coral-pink ribbon round her neck.
cast.portrait: Background: a tall window in the old villa, with stars outside.

cast.name: Jenta som tolvåring
cast.description: Jenta når hun er tolv. Hun lover å holde seg unna den andre døra, og hun mener det, men hun tenker på den hele tida.
cast.look: A slender, long-legged girl of twelve with a heart-shaped face, a button nose, big grey-green eyes and a thoughtful frown, and long ash-blonde hair in a loose ponytail with a coral-pink hair tie. She wears an oversized peach-coloured hoodie, grey joggers and scuffed white trainers, with the small old key with its round tag on a coral-pink cord round her neck.
cast.portrait: Background: the long corridor at night, lit silver.

cast.name: Den unge kvinnen (den stumme bruden)
cast.description: Jenta som de fattige foreldrene lar gudmoren ta med seg etter dåpen, og som mister stemmen, gifter seg med prinsen i en brudekjole fra loftet og må se tre nyfødte barn forsvinne.
cast.look: A strikingly lovely young woman of seventeen with a heart-shaped face, a small nose, large grey-green eyes with dark lashes and a soft, silent mouth. Her long ash-blonde hair falls loose to her waist. She wears a simple, long ivory wedding dress with a lace bodice and long lace sleeves, and a long, thin tulle veil pinned in her hair, and she goes barefoot.
cast.portrait: Background: the leafy branches of the old oak over the spring.

cast.name: Prinsen (arvingen)
cast.description: En ung arving i et hus alle i distriktet kaller slottet; han finner henne i treet over kilden, insisterer på å gifte seg med henne og prøver å beskytte henne med vakter og kameraer som likevel ikke virker.
cast.look: A tall, easy-going young man of about twenty-five with a long, open face, a strong nose, warm hazel eyes that crinkle when he smiles, wavy light-brown hair swept back to his collar and a short, neatly trimmed light-brown beard. He wears a teal-blue wool overshirt over a pale-grey T-shirt, charcoal chinos, brown suede boots and a thin silver signet ring.
cast.portrait: Background: the park and the big white manor everyone calls the castle.

cast.name: Prinsens mor
cast.description: En kjølig og mistenksom matriark som ser den stumme bruden som en trussel, driver fram dommen om straff, men endrer seg når barna kommer tilbake og sannheten blir sagt høyt.
cast.look: A short, stout, stiff-backed woman of about sixty-five with a round double chin, a haughty little upturned nose, small sharp black eyes, thin pencilled eyebrows and pursed lips. Her silver-white hair is set high in stiff curls. She wears a high-necked deep-purple wool dress with a white collar, a string of large pearls, a heavy gold ring with a red stone, and gold-rimmed glasses on a thin gold chain that she lifts to peer at people.
cast.portrait: Background: the grand dining room of the manor.

places.name: the Long Corridor
places.look: A long, cold, quiet corridor in a big old wooden villa: pale grey panelled walls, worn wide floorboards, tall windows with thin white curtains along one side, and at the far end three plain white panel doors side by side, each with an old brass handle, all shut.

places.name: the Spring in the Park
places.look: A small, clear spring edged with a low ring of old dressed stones, in a quiet, overgrown corner of a big park, with an old, gnarled oak leaning right over the water. Beyond the trees, lawns lead up to a big white nineteenth-century manor house with two small towers, which everyone calls the castle.

places.name: the Bonfire Field
places.look: A wide, grassy field below the park of a big white manor, sloping gently down towards dark forest, with an avenue of old trees along one side. In the middle of the field, a tall midsummer bonfire of old planks, pallets and branches is stacked high and tight around a tall wooden pole.

cover.prompt: The Young Woman sits barefoot on a broad branch of the old oak over the Spring in the Park at dawn, in her ivory wedding dress, her long veil caught and trailing in the branches, looking down at her own lovely face mirrored in the still water. In the pale sky above the trees hang a sharp white star, a fading moon and the first gold of the rising sun.
cover.caption: Det satt en brud i treet over kilden.
cover.alt: En vakker ung kvinne i brudekjole sitter barbeint i et gammelt tre over en kilde, med sløret hengende i greinene, og ser ansiktet sitt i vannet. På himmelen ser man en stjerne, en blek måne og sola som står opp.

illustrations.anchor: Hun holdt fram en nøkkel med en liten brikke.
illustrations.prompt: Dusk in steady rain where a muddy gravel road runs into a dark spruce forest. A long dark car stands at the roadside with its headlights on, and beside it stands the Godmother, dry and spotless, holding out a small old key with a little round tag. Facing her, a tired, thin man of about thirty in a cheap, soaked rain jacket, with a rucksack on his back, stares down at her clean shoes in the mud.
illustrations.caption: Hun holdt fram en nøkkel med en liten brikke.
illustrations.alt: Det regner i skumringen. Ved en bil med lysene på står en dame i lang, lys kåpe og blått sjal og holder fram en liten nøkkel. En sliten mann med sekk på ryggen ser ned på de rene skoene hennes i sølen.

illustrations.anchor: Morgenen etter sto bilen utenfor huset.
illustrations.prompt: Morning outside a small, shabby rented house at the end of a gravel road where the forest begins. A long dark car waits with two men in dark coats sitting silently in the back seat. On the doorstep, a young mother with a tight, set face lays her baby daughter, dressed in the one fine little dress they have for her, into the arms of the Godmother without looking up.
illustrations.caption: Så la hun henne i armene til damen, gikk inn og lukket døra.
illustrations.alt: Foran et lite, slitent hus venter en lang, mørk bil med to menn i mørke frakker i baksetet. På trappa legger en ung mor babyen sin, i den eneste fine kjolen hun har, i armene til damen i den lyse kåpa.

illustrations.anchor: Jenta holdt seg unna i fire dager.
illustrations.prompt: In the Long Corridor, the Little Girl has opened the first of the three white doors just a crack. A small, hard, white star shoots out and straight up through the ceiling, leaving no hole behind, and its sharp light blazes on her face. She stands frozen with one hand still on the brass handle and her mouth open.
illustrations.caption: Vips! så fløy det ut en stjerne. Den gikk rett gjennom taket uten å lage hull.
illustrations.alt: Den lille jenta har åpnet den første av tre hvite dører på gløtt. En liten, hvit og skarp stjerne skyter ut og rett opp gjennom taket, og jenta står stiv med hånda på dørhåndtaket.

illustrations.anchor: Jenta lovte det, og hun mente det.
illustrations.prompt: Evening in the Long Corridor. The Girl has opened the second white door a crack, and a huge, cold, silver-white moon, far bigger than she expected, glides out past her and on out through a tall window without breaking the glass. She presses herself flat against the wall with wide eyes, her ponytail and face lit silver.
illustrations.caption: Månen var større enn hun hadde trodd, og kaldere.
illustrations.alt: Jenta, som nå er tolv, har åpnet den andre døra på gløtt. En diger, kald, sølvhvit måne glir forbi henne og ut gjennom vinduet uten å knuse glasset. Hun presser seg mot veggen.

illustrations.anchor: Varmen kom først, slik den gjør når man åpner ytterdøra en dag i juli.
illustrations.prompt: In the Long Corridor on a summer afternoon, the third white door stands open a crack, and a glowing golden ball rises out of the room, flooding the whole corridor with dazzling light and heat. The Young Woman, in the ivory wedding dress and veil she found in the attic, stands with her eyes screwed shut, unable to look away, her hair and veil stirring in the hot light.
illustrations.caption: Så kom lyset, og hele gangen ble gyllen.
illustrations.alt: Den tredje døra står på gløtt, og en glødende, gyllen kule stiger ut og fyller gangen med lys og varme. Jenta står i brudekjolen fra loftet med øynene knepet sammen.

illustrations.prompt: The verge of a main road through spruce forest on a grey summer day. The Young Woman walks barefoot along the verge in her ivory wedding dress and veil. A car has stopped beside her with the window down, and the driver, a middle-aged man in a fleece, leans across to ask if she needs help; she looks at him and cannot answer. Another car slows down as it passes.
illustrations.caption: En bil stoppet, og sjåføren spurte om hun trengte hjelp. Hun kunne ikke svare.
illustrations.alt: Den unge kvinnen går barbeint langs riksveien i brudekjole og slør. En bil har stoppet ved siden av henne, og sjåføren lener seg over og spør om hun trenger hjelp.

illustrations.anchor: Hun satte fra seg mugga, gikk opp til huset og sa opp.
illustrations.prompt: Early morning at the Spring in the Park, with mist over the grass. A young summer temp in a black T-shirt and a white apron has set down her glass jug on the stone edge of the spring and marches off towards the big white house with her chin in the air, one hand on her cheek. High above her in the old oak over the spring, the Young Woman sits in silence, her veil caught in the branches, and watches her go.
illustrations.caption: «Ser jeg sånn ut», sa hun, «er jeg for god til å bære vann.»
illustrations.alt: En sommervikar har satt fra seg mugga ved kilden og går opp mot det store, hvite huset med nesen i været. Høyt oppe i eika over kilden sitter den unge kvinnen i brudekjole og ser etter henne.

illustrations.anchor: Hun var barbeint, og sløret hadde hengt seg fast i en grein.
illustrations.prompt: At the Spring in the Park in soft morning light, the Prince stands at the foot of the old oak with both hands raised, talking calmly, the way you talk to a cat on a roof. Above him, the Young Woman, barefoot in her wedding dress, her veil caught on a branch, looks down at him in silence and begins to climb down.
illustrations.caption: Han rakte opp hendene, og hun kom ned.
illustrations.alt: Prinsen står ved foten av eika over kilden og rekker hendene opp mot den unge kvinnen. Hun sitter barbeint i brudekjole i treet, med sløret hengende fast i en grein, og begynner å klatre ned.

illustrations.prompt: Night in a room in the east wing fitted out like a hospital room, with a hospital bed, monitors whose screens flicker with grey snow, and cameras in the corners. Four guards in dark uniforms have fallen asleep on chairs along the wall, and a midwife sleeps sitting up with her blue gloves still on. The Young Woman, exhausted in a pale hospital gown, lies in the bed with her newborn baby, and beside the bed, far too close, stands the Godmother.
illustrations.caption: Da barnet var født, sto gudmoren ved senga. Ingen hadde sett henne komme inn.
illustrations.alt: Fire vakter og ei jordmor sover på stolene i et rom med sykehusseng og flimrende skjermer. Den unge kvinnen ligger i senga med den nyfødte babyen, og ved senga står gudmoren.

illustrations.anchor: «Trollmennesker brenner man», sa prinsens mor ved frokosten
illustrations.prompt: Breakfast in the grand dining room of the big white manor. The Prince's Mother sits very upright at the head of a long table, calmly buttering a slice of toast and speaking without looking up. Across from her, the Prince, pale and unshaven, stares at her over an untouched cup of tea. Through the tall window behind her, a big, shaggy, overgrown hedge fills the garden.
illustrations.caption: «Trollmennesker brenner man», sa prinsens mor ved frokosten.
illustrations.alt: Prinsens mor sitter rank ved enden av et langt frokostbord og smører en brødskive. Prinsen sitter blek overfor henne og stirrer på henne. Utenfor vinduet ser man en hekk som trenger klipping.

illustrations.prompt: Midsummer Eve in the golden evening light on the Bonfire Field. The tall bonfire stands built high and tight around its pole. Two estate workers in green work clothes hold up a life-sized straw witch in old clothes and a headscarf, ready to lift her onto the top, but the Prince's Mother, standing stiffly nearby with her glasses raised, lifts one hand and shakes her head.
illustrations.caption: Hvert år satte de en heks av halm på toppen. I år ba prinsens mor dem la være.
illustrations.alt: Det store sankthansbålet står ferdig bygd rundt en påle. To arbeidere holder opp en heks av halm og gamle klær, men prinsens mor rekker opp hånda og rister på hodet.

illustrations.anchor: Da kom gudmoren opp fra parken, der det ikke gikk noen sti.
illustrations.prompt: Midsummer dusk on the Bonfire Field. The Godmother walks up out of the dark trees of the park, where there is no path, with two small children by the hand and a baby on her arm, glowing softly. A ring of guards in helmets steps aside for her without knowing why, and behind them the staff of the house watch in silence. Beyond them rises the tall bonfire stack against the pale night sky.
illustrations.caption: Da kom gudmoren opp fra parken med to små barn ved hånda og et tredje på armen.
illustrations.alt: I skumringen kommer gudmoren opp fra parken med to små barn ved hånda og en baby på armen. Vaktene med hjelmer flytter seg for henne. Bak dem reiser det store sankthansbålet seg.

illustrations.prompt: Sunrise after the midsummer night on the Bonfire Field, the bonfire burnt down behind them to a heap of grey ash. The Young Woman, freed, sits on the dewy grass in a plain white dress, without her veil, holding the smallest baby in a borrowed blanket and talking and talking. The Prince sits close beside her with a toddler on his knee, and the eldest child, about two, stands by them. The Prince's Mother bends stiffly and lays her hand carefully on the eldest child's hair.
illustrations.caption: Så gikk hun bort og la hånda på håret til den eldste, forsiktig.
illustrations.alt: Ved soloppgang sitter den unge kvinnen i gresset med den minste i et teppe, og prinsen sitter ved siden av henne med et lite barn på fanget. Prinsens mor legger hånda forsiktig på håret til det eldste barnet.
